elements.label: Figure 2.5
elements.title: Matching the ambition of standards with compliance capacity
elements.content: Chart type: 2D conceptual chart / matrix with two axes (Ambition of standard on the y-axis from Low to High, Compliance capacity on the x-axis from Low to High). A red diagonal dashed line represents the 'Balanced path of ambition and capacity'. A horizontal dotted line indicates 'Minimum standard'. Panel elements and arrows: 1. Top-left quadrant (High ambition, Low capacity): An arrow labeled 'Adapt and build compliance capacity' pointing right/down towards the balanced path. 2. Bottom-left quadrant (Low/Minimum ambition, Low capacity): A red arrow pointing up-right labeled 'Raise standard and build compliance capacity'. 3. Bottom-right quadrant (Low ambition, High capacity): A vertical blue arrow pointing up labeled 'Increase ambition'.
